subject: RESERVE clause
notes: NOW (kb/Work PB3334, INDEXED on the keyed store engine): the INDEXED organization moved to the keyed store engine (kb/Work PB3334; DESIGN-runtime-library 2.2.1.4): the input-output areas are the page cache's floor for both organizations, sized in KeyedConnector.Attach (2.2.1.13); the whole store's transfer buffer went with it. kb/Work PB643 (landed, wave 1020 B). cite.py --check 12.4.5.14.3 "If the RESERVE clause is specified, the number of input-output areas allocated is equal to the value of integer-1" -> OK §12.4.5.14.3 1); "If the RESERVE clause is not specified, the number of input-output areas allocated is specified by the implementor" -> OK. Both halves: the binder reads integer-1 into FileModel.ReserveAreas, the emitter registers it on every registering arm (record-described files of all three organizations and report files) through CobolFile.RegisterReserve, and FileConnector.InputOutputAreas (default HostFile.ImplementorInputOutputAreas = 1, DOC-A.1-164) is spent by ONE sizing site, HostFile.InputOutputAreaBuffer (areas x 4,096 bytes): the sequential reader's and writer's buffer (the host handle beneath is unbuffered in every posture, PB753's one-buffer rule) and the keyed connector's store-transfer buffer (KeyedConnector._areas). Measured before PB643's fix (probe E:/COBOL-coord/scratch/w1020b/probes/r1.cob, r4.cob): RESERVE 1 and RESERVE 4 both let a sibling reader see 64 of 100 64-byte records written under SHARING WITH READ ONLY (the 4,096-byte host buffer whatever the clause said). PB643 made the count decide when the records left the area (064, 000), and kb/Work PB1587 then retired that observable: a WRITE under a sharing mode that admits a reader releases its record at the statement (GR12), so the count of areas changes nothing a sibling sees (conformance:cases/12.4.5.14-RESERVE/pb643_reserve_areas_visibility reads 100 in every phase, 2002/2014/2023 identical); every organization round-trips through its areas at 85 (conformance:cases/12.4.5.14-RESERVE/pb643_reserve_areas_all_organizations). Limit integer-1 <= 524,287 (cite.py --check 4.2.15 "A conforming implementation may place such limits" -> OK), COBOL2897 above it (conformance:cases/12.4.5.14-RESERVE/pb643-reserve-beyond-limit). || kb/Work PB2693 (w1045d): a relative or indexed connector's areas are no longer its store handle's stream buffer, which no store byte passed through (the load and the persist are positional, PB2660), so RESERVE allocated memory nothing used;
